selection_contract.coordinate_space: three masked deep-error sites compacted in site-major and flattened-storage order
selection_contract.selection_point: after the complete current energy gradient has been produced
selection_contract.ranking: descending exact binary32 squared magnitude with ascending storage index as the tie break
selection_contract.mass_arithmetic: exact nonnegative integer numerators over the common dyadic denominator 2^298
selection_contract.zero_boundary: a zero direction retains a deterministic budget but exposes no relative captured-mass certificate
selection_contract.changing_frontier: the previous selected indices are re-evaluated against the complete current gradient and never assumed valid at the next sweep

safeguard_contract.proposal: one sparse projected-gradient endpoint using the registered rate and backtracking schedule
safeguard_contract.acceptance: energy no larger than the current energy plus the registered monotone tolerance
safeguard_contract.fallback: the registered full-gradient endpoint under the same backtracking schedule
safeguard_contract.failure: the read-only probe rejects the row if neither sparse nor baseline endpoint passes
safeguard_contract.state_integrity: model parameters, module modes, and dropout rates are restored exactly

test_contract.positive: a tied 1,-2,2,0 direction chooses indices 1 then 2 and captures exactly 8/9 of squared mass
test_contract.zero: a zero direction refuses a relative mass fraction
test_contract.changing_frontier_negative: a one-coordinate frontier that captures all of direction 1,0 captures zero of the next direction 0,1
test_contract.runtime: a two-sweep model probe is read-only, endpoint-monotone, satisfies exact selected-plus-tail mass accounting at every sweep, and records the final sparse-to-full-reference state relation
test_contract.invalid: wrong dtype, invalid coordinate fraction, and duplicate declared indices are rejected

non_claims: pointwise captured mass is not a uniform curvature or convergence certificate
top-k magnitude selection is not claimed to be optimal for future sweeps
the counterfactual sparse trajectory does not modify the registered trainer
the finite full-gradient trajectory is not identified with an exact equilibrium
no speed, verifier-yield, or efficacy improvement is inferred
